name: Isabelle Dubois
bio:
Isabelle's journey into motorsport started unconventionally. After years as a structural engineer for bridges, she sought a field that demanded precision at a faster pace. Drawn to the intricate composite work on racing cars, she retrained and joined a small Formula Ford team, quickly proving her aptitude. Her attention to detail and problem-solving skills soon led to opportunities in higher categories.

At Herberth Motorsport, Isabelle is known for her methodical approach to composite repair and fabrication. She meticulously analyzes damage, ensuring repairs are not only structurally sound but also aerodynamically optimized. While not one for grand pronouncements, her quiet competence inspires confidence throughout the team. She is particularly adept at working with carbon fibre, a skill she constantly hones through research and experimentation, adapting aerospace technologies to the demanding world of motorsport.

Isabelle's distinctive approach lies in her blend of engineering rigor and practical experience. She values collaboration, frequently seeking input from drivers and mechanics to improve her work. Her commitment to continuous improvement and quiet dedication make her an invaluable asset to Herberth Motorsport.

physical.description: A petite woman with kind eyes and a focused gaze.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook filled with sketches and calculations.
Insists on cleaning her workstation before and after every task.
Has a collection of small, vintage tools she uses for delicate repairs.
